// installOfficialExtension installs the given official extension and reports
// the result on stderr.
func installOfficialExtension(io *iostreams.IOStreams, em extensions.ExtensionManager, ext *extensions.OfficialExtension) error {
	repo := ext.Repository()
	io.StartProgressIndicatorWithLabel(fmt.Sprintf("Installing %s/%s...", ext.Owner, ext.Repo))
	installErr := em.Install(repo, "")
	io.StopProgressIndicator()
	if installErr != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to install extension: %w", installErr)
	}

	fmt.Fprintf(io.ErrOut, "Successfully installed %s/%s\n", ext.Owner, ext.Repo)
	return nil
}

func installOfficialExtension(io *iostreams.IOStreams, em extensions.ExtensionManager, ext *extensions.OfficialExtension) error {
	stderr := io.ErrOut

	repo := ext.Repository()
	io.StartProgressIndicatorWithLabel(fmt.Sprintf("Installing %s/%s...", ext.Owner, ext.Repo))

	io.StopProgressIndicator()
	if installErr != nil {

	}

	return nil
}

// installOfficialExtension installs the given official extension and reports
// success on stderr.
func installOfficialExtension(io *iostreams.IOStreams, em extensions.ExtensionManager, ext *extensions.OfficialExtension) error {
	repo := ext.Repository()
	io.StartProgressIndicatorWithLabel(fmt.Sprintf("Installing %s/%s...", ext.Owner, ext.Repo))
	installErr := em.Install(repo, "")
	io.StopProgressIndicator()
	if installErr != nil {
		return fmt.Errorf("failed to install extension: %w", installErr)
	}

	fmt.Fprintf(io.ErrOut, "Successfully installed %s/%s\n", ext.Owner, ext.Repo)
	return nil
}

func installOfficialExtension(io *iostreams.IOStreams, em extensions.ExtensionManager, ext *extensions.OfficialExtension) error {

}

func installOfficialExtension(io *iostreams.IOStreams, em extensions.ExtensionManager, ext *extensions.OfficialExtension) error {
	stderr := io.ErrOut

	io.StartProgressIndicatorWithLabel(fmt.Sprintf("Installing %s/%s...", ext.Owner, ext.Repo))

	io.StopProgressIndicator()

	}

}

}

func installOfficialExtension(io *iostreams.IOStreams, em extensions.ExtensionManager, ext *extensions.OfficialExtension) error {
	repo := ext.Repository()
